title: Distance from the addressing function to juntas
statement: Let $m$ be a positive integer, and let $A_m$ be the Boolean function on $m+2^m$ signs that uses the first $m$ signs to select one of the remaining $2^m$ signs, using any fixed bijection between the $m$-sign strings and the $2^m$ positions. If a Boolean function $g$ on the same inputs depends on at most $2^{m-1}$ coordinates, then its relative Hamming distance from $A_m$ is at least $1/4$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on $m+2^m$ signs
$g$ depends on a set of at most $2^{m-1}$ coordinates
